title: The Candle in the Tin Mold
youtube_title: The Candle in the Tin Mold | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets a small thing finish its quiet work.
summary: At a bakery kitchen where dough and jam are left to finish, Dahlia wants to check on a small beeswax candle cooling in a tin before it is ready. With Mama nearby, Dahlia leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
